reviews.comment:
Holaa vinimos acá a YPF A.C.A y la verdad que un desastre la atención
Las hamburguesas re frías y un cartón el pan re duro y lo peor q siempre venimos y siempre pasa lo mismo
La ves pasada no nos quisieron hacer de comer porq era tarde pero se supone que esta abierto 24hs y en una ruta
La verdad q un desastre

(Translated by Google)
Hi, we came here to YPF A.C.A. and honestly, the service was a disaster. The hamburgers were freezing cold, the bread was like cardboard, and it was rock hard. The worst part is that we come here every time and it's always the same. Last time they wouldn't cook for us because it was late, but it's supposed to be open 24 hours and on a highway. It was a complete disaster.

reviewReply.comment: Buen día Melodi, lamentamos lo sucedido. Vamos a tener en cuenta lo comentado para mejorar todos los aspectos, y de ser posible te esperamos nuevamente para mejorar tu experiencia.

Buenas tardes vinimos a comer hamburguesas no nos quisieron hacer la que queríamos nos vendieron unas que estaban ahí. Las fuimos a comer estaban re secas de estar en la calentadora. Las 5 hamburguesas 100 mil pesos para lo pésimas que eran. Las papas un cartón corrugado y gusto aceite viejo. Una lastima .antes veníamos siempre con la pelota a pasar el dia en las mesitas. Ahora malisimo

(Translated by Google)
Good afternoon. We came to eat hamburgers, but they wouldn't make the one we wanted and sold us some that were already there. We went to eat them, and they were completely dry from being in the warmer. The five hamburgers cost 100,000 pesos for how awful they were. The fries were like corrugated cardboard and tasted like old oil. It's a shame. We used to come here all the time with our ball to spend the day at the tables. Now it's terrible.

Gracias.
